Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-02
DOC-0044 2026-07-07
MEETING NOTES — Cabin Attachment Filing Across the
Records Desks ;
Date: 2026-07-07
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
Attendees: PERSON-0021 for TEAM-0003; partner team's records
liaison; station filing clerk; cabin desk coordinator.
Purpose: Agree how cabin attachments will be indexed across
the records desks at DEMO-STATION-02. ISSUE-0073, TASK-0192,
and TASK-0193 locate the discussion material.
Decisions The shared filing list will retain the source
heading beside the local filing heading. A document may arrive
with a sender's title that differs from the station's index
label; keeping both lets a later clerk retrace the search
without guessing which subject was intended.
If a paper is found under a different folder heading, keep a
dated location-correction note with the source route and the
receiving location. Do not silently refile it and discard the
trail. The collecting coordinator needs to know where a search
began as well as where the Paper was found.
The partner liaison will confirm which attachment heading
belongs to each discussion reference. TEAM-0003 will supply
the receiving filing contact, while the cabin desk coordinator
retains the appointment with the requester.
Action items
~ Owner: Station filing clerk. Due: 2026-07-08. add source and
filing headings to the working index.
~ Owner: Partner records liaison. Due: 2026-07-09. Resolve
ambiguous attachment headings with the requesting desk.
D. Worker 0021
Demo Worker 0021, Demo Team 03
